fee_details:
* Joining Fee: Rs.499 (Waived off on spends of Rs.10000 within 45 days of Card issuance)
* Annual Fee: Rs.499 (2nd year onwards); annual fee will be waived off if you spend more than Rs. 75,000 annually
* Add-on card, Joining and Annual Fee charges for regular renewal of card: Waived off
* Cash payment fee: Rs.200
* Fee for duplicate statement: Waived off
* Copy request fee: Waived off
* Cheque bounce charges: Waived off
* Mobile alerts for transactions made: Free
* Charges for balance enquiry: Waived off
* Finance charges: 3.4% per month
* Fee for withdrawal of cash: 2.5% of the cash amount subject to a minimum amount of Rs.500
* Late payment fee:
    * Nil total amount due is up to Rs.1000
    * Rs.300 total amount due is between Rs.1001 - Rs.3000
    * Rs.500 total amount due is between Rs.3001 - Rs.5000
    * Rs.800 total amount due is between Rs.5001 - Rs.10000
    * Rs.1000 total amount due is Rs.10,001 and above
* Over limit penalty: 3% of the over limit amount subject to a minimum amount of Rs.500
* Cheque bounce or return or auto debit reversal: 3% of the amount subject to a minimum of Rs.50
* Surcharge on purchase or cancellation of railway tickets: As per rules by IRCTC
* Fee for foreign currency transaction: 3.5% of the total transaction amount
* Rent transaction fee: 1% capped on Rs.1,500 for every transaction
* Dynamic currency conversion fee on-refund/redemption: No

Online:
1. Visit Axis Bank’s official website.
2. On the menu bar, click on ‘Explore Products’, under which click on ‘Cards’, following ‘Credit Cards’.
3. Next, find Axis Bank ACE Credit Card and click on the link ‘Explore More’ if you wish to know more about the card; otherwise you can click on the option ‘Apply Now’.
4. Clicking on ‘Apply Now’, a new page/window will open.
5. Thereafter, click on ‘Choose’, choose whether you are an existing customer or a new customer and provide your details such as your name, state, and city in which you reside, mobile number, your monthly income and go to the next details.
6. Click on the box which mentions where your source of income and professional details.
7. Click on ‘Call Me’. A representative from the bank will get in touch with you and will assist you with the process of applying for the credit card.
Offline: You can visit the nearest Axis Bank branch along with all the necessary documents. A representative from the bank will help you with the process of applying for the Axis Bank ACE Credit Card.

Can I apply for an Axis Bank ACE Credit: Yes, you can apply for an Axis Bank ACE Credit Card online.
I am a Non-Resident Indian (NRI). Can I: No, you are not eligible for Axis Card. As you are a Non-Resident Indian as this card is specifically designed for Indian residents only.
I have lost my credit card. What should: In case you have lost your credit card you must immediately contact Axis Bank’s customer care desk or link your card to be blocked.
How can I get my credit card replaced?: You can get your damaged/lost credit card replaced by contacting the bank. You can also contact the banks' customer care executive and request a replacement for your credit card.
Is there any joining fee for Axis Bank A: Yes, there will be a joining fee of Rs.499 However it will be waived off on spends of Rs.10000 within 45 days of card set up.
Will I get any cashback on paying throug: You will receive 5% cashback on paying bills through Google Pay using your Ace Credit Card.
Does the Axis Bank ACE Credit Card offer: Yes, with the Axis Bank ACE Credit Card, you get a 2% fuel surcharge waiver at fuel stations above India.
